source: Who's On First (whosonfirst-data-admin-us latest dist, the copy downloaded 2026-10-31): placetype neighbourhood (Zetashapes, Quattroshapes) plus placetype locality (Davidson County's satellite cities Belle Meade, Berry Hill, Forest Hills and Oak Hill, Quattroshapes; the City of Nashville itself left out) as the coarser fallback, the smallest outline winning; current, polygon geometries whose label point is inside Davidson County (config/metro-bounds/nashville.json); none from OpenStreetMap; WOF's bare "Northeast" and "Southeast" left out; simplified to ~20 m, coordinates to 4 decimals (D-1200).
